title: DEBRISVERSE
description:
Notice Regarding System EnvironmentDEBRISVERSE includes visual effects and puzzles that utilize features of the Windows OS environment.
For the best and intended experience, playing on a Windows PC is strongly recommended.
(Note: On non-Windows platforms, such as Steam Deck, certain effects or puzzles may not function as intended.)

Об игре

That debt is a trap.

Welcome to DEBRISVERSE.Your mission is to crush endless space debris from the cockpit of a retro-futuristic spaceship to pay off an astronomical debt of $100 million. B.R.I.S. Corporation guarantees a clean and safe workplace.

...As long as you do not discover the "truth" behind B.R.I.S. Corporation.

------------------------------------------------
[SYSTEM_WARNING: Unauthorized Access Detected]
> Message from the Recruiter:
> The working environment at our company (B.R.I.S. Corporation) is perfectly sound.
> Rumors regarding "illegal modification patches" and "endless debt loops" are entirely unfounded.
> Workers must immediately return to their stations and resume crushing debris.
------------------------------------------------

Overwhelming Inflation & The Joy of Destruction• Intuitive Destruction: Select debris with your mouse and shatter it instantly. As your work efficiency increases, an overwhelming torrent of debris and an eruption of credits will cover your screen. Experience the sensory overload of exponential numerical inflation.

Efficiency Driven by Choice• Roguelite Power-Ups: Every time you level up, you are presented with three random upgrade proposals. Will you maximize your raw firepower or stack up your credit gains? Your choices dictate how fast you reach "Debt Zero."

Reinvest or Repay? Strategic Cash Flow• Immediate Power or Long-Term Benefits: Do you pour your hard-earned cash into tool upgrades for immediate destructive power, or do you prioritize repaying your debt to unlock permanent discount privileges on future upgrades? Your financial strategy determines your speed to freedom.

• Expanding Hazardous Sectors: As you prove your ability to repay, B.R.I.S. Corp will grant access to hazardous sectors teeming with higher-density junk and grant authorization to destroy massive debris. Venturing into more dangerous workplaces causes your earnings to shoot up by orders of magnitude.

Recovering "Fragment Shards": Lost TechnologyRemnants of Lost Tech: Hidden within the debris are rare remnants of lost technology. Collect these precious items to permanently boost your tools' performance and construct the ultimate destruction build. Mysterious signals are emanating from these Fragments, though there is currently no way to decipher them.

Paying It Off Is Just the Beginning: Meta-Elements to Uncover the Conspiracy• Direct System Interference: Paying off the $100 million debt will not free you from your labor. Pay close attention to screen noise and unnatural glitches. Bypassing company protocol—such as accessing hidden terminals—is the key to progressing.

• 7 Distinct Endings: Your system interferences and choices act as hidden triggers, branching the narrative into 7 distinct endings. Destroy the dystopian corporate system and claim true freedom.

A Nostalgic Workspace• Retro-Future UI: Immerse yourself in the unique atmosphere of working behind a flickering CRT monitor. The aesthetic blend of pixel art and digital noise adds flavor to your solitary labor in the void.

• Your Partner, "Bris-kun": The B.R.I.S. Corp mascot is here to support your labor—sometimes with kindness, and sometimes with cold, corporate efficiency.

■ BGM:MusMus
description_short: That debt is a trap. Crush space debris and use roguelite upgrades to pay off a $100M debt in this sci-fi incremental game. But repayment isn't freedom. Use "meta-elements" to directly hack the system and uncover a dark corporate conspiracy across 7 distinct endings!
